records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Total revenues increased $30.4 billion, or 10.4%, in 2022 compared to 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Beginning in the second quarter and continuing throughout the remainder of the year, the Company experienced reduced customer traffic in its retail pharmacies and MinuteClinic locations due to shelter-in-place orders as well as reduced new therapy prescriptions and decreased long-term care prescription volume as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Net cash provided by operating activities decreased by $2.1 billion in 2022 compared to 2021 primarily due to the timing of payments and higher inventory purchases.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During the year ended December 31, 2022, the impact of COVID-19 within the Health Care Benefits segment has generally stabilized as a result of the Company’s ability to capture COVID-19 related medical costs in pricing.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During the year ended December 31, 2022, the customary quarterly operating income progression in the Retail/LTC segment continued to be impacted by COVID-19.
